title: Final Momentum Expressions
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly derive p_r and p_theta as functions of r, theta, dot{r}, and dot{theta}.

title: Constancy of p_theta
description: Important Criteria: Identify that p_theta is a constant of motion due to the absence of theta in the Lagrangian.

title: Virial Theorem Application
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly apply the virial theorem to show J_r + J_theta = integral of k/r dt.

title: Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: Correctly express the total energy E in terms of kinetic and potential energy.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly evaluate the integral to show (J_r + J_theta) = sqrt(-2pi^2 m k^2/E).

title: Period Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly derive the period tau of the orbit in terms of k, m, and E.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in energy expressions or when applying the virial theorem.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
